acceptance: Compile, persist and read a byte-stable A1/B1/C2 metadata plan on PostgreSQL17 and the SQLite internal metadata path; SQLite public execution remains fail-closed.
Refuse invalid topology before TaskRun/grant/DATA/user-code side effects.

For the A1/B1/C2 fixture, seal four stable unassigned TaskRuns/subtasks and atomically admit them on two workers. Also prove generic N=sum(P) with an N=6/three-worker metadata admission and exact two-worker refusal; no hardcoded four-subtask profile rule.
Preserve old fixed-P2 API/eligibility while capable workers advertise both profiles.
Architect repeats selected server/client/runtime controls before done.
DAG claim, register and activation are typed EXECUTION_PROFILE_NOT_READY; production workers keep advertising/polling fixed-P2 only in NI2-010.
Refuse multiple roots, disconnected operators, fan-in, fewer than three operators, linear-only topology and same-operator input/output UID collision with zero side effects.
Refuse terminal Flow completion for an unadmitted sealed DAG with DAG_NOT_STARTED; old P2 routes refuse DAG IDs with EXECUTION_PROFILE_NOT_READY before DTO projection.

contract.authoring: A new StreamGraph builder validates add() locally and seals the complete graph only through explicit graph.seal(). Context-manager exit never performs HTTP or implicit seal. Existing Task.submit_partitioned_stream and PartitionedStream keep fixed-P2 behavior and typing.
contract.execution_fence: NI2-010 public API ends at graph.seal()->SealedStreamGraph. Server admission exists only as an internal/protected metadata/capacity operation. Production ProcessWorker does not advertise or poll partitioned-dag-v1 yet, and DAG claim/register/activate refuses with EXECUTION_PROFILE_NOT_READY. NI2-012 adds worker advertisement, sealed.start() and a running/wait handle after routing/runtime exists.
contract.identity: Stable graph revision, operator UID, port UID, edge UID, subscriber UID and edge-partition identity exclude TaskRun attempts. Physical subtasks remain ordinary TaskRuns.
contract.keyed_yield: Later keyed edges use explicit KeyedStreamOutput(value,key) encoded by tagged-key-v1. Plain yield remains unchanged; no reserved payload field or server-side callback.
contract.placement: Seal persists the complete topology plus N=sum(operator parallelism) stable unassigned TaskRuns/subtasks, bounded by 128. Admission locks enough eligible workers/capabilities for N placements under the shared max-two-live-children capacity, writes every assigned_worker_id and allocation row atomically, or writes none. SEALED rows are not occupied slots and are invisible to worker poll/claim. Four subtasks/two workers is only the first real A1/B1/C2 fixture; it is not a profile constant.
contract.port_identity: Port identity is qualified by (operator_uid,direction,port_uid), so different operators may reuse names. Within one operator the input and output UIDs must differ.
contract.port_schema_digest: json-value-v1 digest is SHA256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON {"id":"json-value-v1","type":"json-value","version":1} using sorted keys and compact separators.
contract.ports: One named output and at most one named logical input per operator. Portable schema ID json-value-v1 uses exact version/digest equality; Python annotations are not wire identity.
contract.seal_authority: Public metadata seal requires current Flow execution credentials and a matching deployed native snapshot with profile partitioned-dag-v1. Standalone/SQLite compilation uses internal model helpers only.
contract.sqlite_boundary: SQLite supports internal model/service topology compile, metadata seal and read-plan tests without grants, activation or DATA. Public executing seal/admit remains PostgreSQL17-only and returns exact UNSUPPORTED_BACKEND on SQLite.
contract.storage: Reuse existing StreamPartition/StreamRecord/StreamConsumer/StreamCompletion; no second store or client mailbox.
contract.tail: Flow code after graph.wait is supported. A finite Task tail is typed unsupported until its witness binds graph revision, full leaf set and physical retirements.
contract.topology: Exactly one SOURCE root; source has zero inputs, every other operator exactly one input, every operator exactly one named output. All operators must be reachable, indegree<=1, at least 3 operators, at least 2 edges and at least one fan-out. Reject cycles, disconnected/extra roots, duplicate identities, fan-in, multiple outputs, incompatible schemas and unsupported profiles before grant, DATA or user code.
contract.unstarted_terminal: A terminal Flow transition with a SEALED but unadmitted DAG refuses with DAG_NOT_STARTED before false Completed; NI2-010 does not auto-release metadata. Internal cleanup exists for tests/operators; NI2-012 adds runtime start/abort compensation.
contract.worker_capability: Capabilities are additive per (worker, protocol, version); fixed-P2 and DAG coexist and share one max-two-live-children occupancy counter.

NI2-070+: finite Task tail and full acceptance

first_server_slice: Paired PostgreSQL/SQLite migrations for immutable port, edge and edge-partition topology referencing existing StreamPartition rows.
Versioned seal/read-plan DTO/API and additive profile capability.

Transactional topology validation creates N=sum(P) stable unassigned TaskRuns/subtasks; admission atomically persists sufficient-worker placement and N allocation rows, with zero grants/DATA and no partial placement on refusal. Include metadata-only N=6/three-worker positive and two-worker capacity-refusal controls.
PG17 and SQLite controls for cycle, duplicate subscriber, schema mismatch, unsupported fan-in and insufficient region capacity.

client: paired DTO/HTTP mirror after server DTO freeze
public local builder and sealed handle only; no public admit/start/wait in NI2-010
runtime: local StreamGraph validation/seal coordinator only after wire freeze
